title: Understanding your demo subscription
content: Synthetic demo guidance: your subscription has a plan, status, purchase channel, and renewal or end date. Sign in with a demo identity to ask for your subscription status. Public answers cannot reveal account-specific details. This portfolio app does not sell or modify subscriptions.

title: Cancellation for a website purchase
content: Synthetic demo procedure for a website purchase: open the service website's account settings, find Subscription, and follow the cancellation steps there. Keep the confirmation and check the displayed access-end date. If the option is missing or the process fails, ask human support to review it. This demo provides instructions only; it does not cancel anything or promise a refund.

title: Cancellation for an App Store purchase
content: Synthetic demo procedure for an App Store purchase: use the subscription-management area for the Apple account used to purchase the subscription, locate the subscription, and follow the store's cancellation instructions. If it is not listed, check the purchasing account and receipt or ask human support for help. This demo does not connect to Apple or cancel a purchase.

title: Cancellation for a Google Play purchase
content: Synthetic demo procedure for a Google Play purchase: use the subscription-management area for the Google account used to purchase the subscription, locate the subscription, and follow the store's cancellation instructions. If it is not listed, check the purchasing account and receipt or ask human support for help. This demo does not connect to Google Play or cancel a purchase.

title: Billing questions and transaction history
content: Synthetic demo guidance: sign in to view your own mock transaction history, including amount, currency, date, and payment status. A store receipt may help identify the purchase channel. Report unexpected, duplicate, or unrecognized charges for human review. Do not send full card numbers, passwords, or payment credentials in chat.

title: Account access and sign-in help
content: Synthetic demo guidance: check that you are using the same sign-in method and account used for the purchase. A real service may offer an official password-reset flow; never share a password or verification code with support. In this portfolio demo, choose a demo identity and explicitly sign in. Escalate persistent access problems to human support.

title: Privacy and sensitive information
content: Synthetic demo policy: only the signed-in demo customer's subscription, transactions, and tickets may be shown. The optional model receives redacted message text and public articles, never retrieved customer records. Redaction is best effort, so use synthetic information only. A request for data deletion or other privacy action needs human review; this demo does not perform that action.

title: Refund requests and disputed charges
content: Synthetic demo procedure: sign in and describe the charge you want reviewed. A support ticket can link a transaction only after the backend verifies that it belongs to your authenticated account. Human support reviews refund requests and suspicious charges. Creating a ticket does not approve a refund, guarantee eligibility, or move money. The demo never executes financial operations.

title: Basic technical troubleshooting
content: Synthetic demo guidance: check your internet connection, restart the app or browser, and check for available updates. Record the visible error, approximate time, app version, and device type without sending credentials. If the problem continues, ask human support to investigate. Support should not ask you to send a full payment-card number or password.

title: About this independent portfolio demo
content: This is an independent educational portfolio project using invented customers and synthetic support policies. It is not an official Nebula or OBRIO product and has no access to their internal systems. Article review dates describe review of these synthetic demo documents, not verification of any real company's policies.
